notes.title: Big Update for September: Part 1
notes.content: [p]This update brings several improvements, including enhancements to the Desert Level and overall gameplay optimizations.[/p][p]In this substantial update, we are thrilled to present a plethora of improvements and refinements across the entire experience, meticulously designed to enhance player immersion, gameplay fluidity, and visual fidelity. At the heart of these enhancements lies the Desert Level—the grand and final stage of the journey—where L33na, having traversed perilous terrains, overcome formidable challenges, and deciphered countless enigmas, now stands in triumphant glory. Here, she celebrates her monumental achievement: the successful collection of all fragments of the ancient and mysterious Lok'vyr, a feat that signifies not only her mastery of the trials set before her but also the culmination of an epic saga filled with discovery, strategy, and unwavering determination. Every dune, every ruin, and every hidden alcove has been meticulously polished to ensure that this ultimate level reflects the grandeur and narrative weight of L33na’s victorious journey, offering players a deeply satisfying and richly layered conclusion to her extraordinary adventure.[/p]

notes.title: Patch 1.01 – Scene 1: Slum
notes.content:
This update includes a small but important fix addressing collider issues in Scene 1 – Slum, affecting both solid objects and trigger interactions.

Important:
Due to occasional inconsistencies with Steam’s auto-update system, it is strongly recommended to uninstall the previous version and perform a clean reinstall of the game. This will ensure all updated files are correctly applied and prevent potential bugs related to leftover data from older builds.

notes.title: L33na Has Launched – Let the Hunt Begin
notes.content: [p]L33na and her crew are finally hitting the grid. In a decaying world shaped by machine cults and corporate manipulation, rival gangs race to retrieve scattered fragments—pieces of a powerful artifact left behind by the elusive Puritarchs.[/p][p]Play solo or alongside the chaos of unpredictable factions. Every encounter is a test of wit, survival, and strategy. Can you stay ahead long enough to put the pieces together?[/p][p]Your mission starts now. The signal is live.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3805390/L33na_Redpepper/"][/dynamiclink][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45676668/a7d06e2a7e437901d4b8f326b2411a2f3cbf0602.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Coming soon - L33na Redpepper
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone! After two years without releasing a new game, we’re thrilled to announce the launch of [i]L33na Redpepper[/i], our newest project and a big step forward for our studio.[/p][p]Our previous games were made using much older versions of Unity, which limited what we could achieve. Now, with [i]L33na[/i], we’re exploring modern Unity features like URP and HDRP, and writing much cleaner, more efficient code. We’re tackling two major priorities: improving FPS while delivering better visual quality, and minimizing bugs for a smoother experience. While we focused on refining this new project, much of the technology and features we’re developing for [i]L33na[/i] will also help us enhance some of our older games in the future. For those who have supported us since the beginning, we have a special surprise waiting — check it out on the game page![/p][p]We’re excited to share this new chapter with you and hope you enjoy the journey as much as we do![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3805390/L33na_Redpepper/"][/dynamiclink][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45676668/3dd2b276cfffa8415ff33684b29c5ad69d0ec140.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p]
